主要内容: On May 12, 2014, Karyn Mashima informed Henry Schein, Inc. of her decision not to seek re-election to the board of directors at its 2014 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. She will continue to serve as a director and a member of the Strategic Advisory Committee until May 28, 2014. The Board’s Nominating and Governance Committee did not recommend, and the Board does not intend to nominate, a replacement for Ms. Mashima to stand for election as a director at the Annual Meeting. The vacancy will be filled in due course.
